contact.name: Helena Abela
contact.evidence_quote: Discover Deheb, Malta’s jewellery specialists in 18 carat gold and soon-to-launch sterling silver collections. Founded by sisters Helena Abela and Amanda Zammit, Deheb is rooted in Maltese heritage and craftsmanship. Together, they collaborate with local jewellers, craftsmen, and private collectors to bring you a curated selection of unique antique treasures, Maltese designs and timeless keepsakes — one-of-a-kind pieces that tell stories across generations.
